name: Cocoa Consult
concept: A warm consultation room on paper: Astryx Chocolate tokens, soft cream surfaces, a booking card that sits in the hero like a calm appointment slip.
style: warm editorial, soft cards, rounded containers (radius-container 12px, radius-page 24px)
signature: Hero consultation card (Astryx Card on --color-background-card) with hours, phone and the one CTA
Treatments as three grouped Astryx List blocks with ruled rows, not repeated cards
Founder note set in Fraunces italic with a portrait placeholder frame
imagery: warm natural-light still life: linen, ceramics, soft botanicals in cream and cocoa tones; no faces
why: Astryx Chocolate is already the brand's plum-brown and cream: warm, trusted, never clinical.

name: Slate Ledger
concept: Precise and transparent: Astryx Stone slate neutrals, a numbered index of treatments and a price ledger that reads like a clear medical menu.
style: structured grid, thin rules, numbered indexes, small radii (radius-element 8px); dark slate (#25252a) hero band and footer, light body
signature: Hero: oversized Montserrat statement left, numbered treatment index 01-03 right
Pricing as an Astryx Table with unit / syringe / vial / session columns and clear placeholders
StatusDot row: Sandy Springs open by appointment, Chicago waitlist open
imagery: cool, precise still life: glass, stone, clean light on neutral backgrounds
why: For careful, informed patients: every option, unit and step laid out plainly before they book.

name: After Hours
concept: Astryx Chocolate in dark mode: deep plum-brown like the current hero, gold-caramel accent, a quiet luxury evening mood.
style: dark, cinematic, generous space, hairline gold rules
signature: Full-bleed dark botanical hero with the promise set large in Crimson Text
'You, with the cherry on top' as a centred pull line between sections
Accordion FAQ (Astryx Collapsible) with the only motion: a 175ms open state
imagery: low-key dark florals (lilies, hydrangea) on deep backgrounds, warm side light
why: Keeps the brand's own plum-brown night mood, now on a consistent system.

name: Garden Script
concept: Astryx Matcha's soft sage and rounded shapes with a handwritten script heading that echoes 'by Bita': fresh, natural, friendly.
signature: Centred script headline over a large rounded arch photo
Process as 4 rounded steps on sage surfaces
Matcha green accent for the CTA and key links; a single soft rose (#f3d9d3) surface for the waitlist band
imagery: fresh green botanicals, leaves and soft daylight; natural and alive
why: Says 'natural results' visually: fresh, friendly and personal for newcomers to injectables.

name: White Gallery
concept: Astryx Neutral at its most minimal: white space, one typeface, big images and quiet black type, like a modern gallery.
style: minimal, monochrome, large imagery, tight sans type
signature: Hero collage of three framed images with a short black headline
Treatments in a three-column gallery with captions, then a ruled price list
Monochrome footer with hours as an Astryx MetadataList
imagery: sculptural, gallery-like still life: white flowers, plaster, soft shadows
why: Lets the work and the consultation speak: modern, quiet confidence for a boutique practice.
